authorization: Owner explicitly requested execution with existing applications left running. Host-pressure gate waived for bounded build and functional visual validation, not a representative performance claim.

build.limits: Heap limit applies to each Node process; Next used seven static-page workers. This was not a single-worker build. Runtime sources were unchanged; generated next-env.d.ts diff restored.

browser.mode: One installed headless Chrome/SwiftShader session at a time, local production server, actual local bundle and OneMap raster; service worker bypassed

firstAttempt.outcome: Harness serialization error after successful viewport, gap and lamp checks. Synthetic map.fire returned a Map; corrected to void. Not an uncaught application failure.

browser.primaryViewports: All four primary-run loaded captures have four current-key route features, loaded basemap/source, stable screenshot brackets and no horizontal overflow or metrics/attribution overlap.
browser.sourceWrites: One initial shiokest-route setData call containing four features in each run. Not a clean timing comparison with earlier diagnosis.
browser.optionalLayers: First run completed lamp source publication with 1180 points and zero route writes; gap focus likewise avoided route writes. Completion lamp window had no writes yet; positive loaded-lamp evidence rests on the first run.
browser.recovery: Retry/style replacement republish all four route-owned sources; four current rendered features recover. Actual exit click selects alternate, renders three current-key features, clears old gap and displays 110 m, 0% covered, 110 m uncovered, 50 m longest gap.
browser.basemapLimit: Completion desktop and alternate captures report basemapLoaded=false while visible tiles/current routes render. Not every raster request completed. Primary four captures and completion retry/style captures report true.

acceptance: Actual-build browser/visual evidence supports source-separation functional acceptance. Representative latency, native-phone checks, service-worker-on release checks and M12 budgets remain separate. No baseline/treatment timing comparison or speedup claimed.
findings: Current build renders the selected walk at all four required viewport sizes.
Optional lamp/gap updates avoid route writes; recovery and alternate selection work in the browser.
Initial harness failure retained and corrected; no product fix required.
Execution under load provided functional evidence, not a speedup measurement.
disagreements: None with explicit owner authorization to proceed under load; unrelated applications left running.
